cohort: 100 premature infants with corrected ages of 18-24 months and birth weights of 1500-1999 g.
finding: Premature infants with birth weights of 1500-1999 g exhibited considerable delays in several developmental areas, with both biological and environmental factors contributing to reduced scores and developmental delays.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was associated with a reduction in developmental scores and an increased risk of delay in at least one developmental domain.
cross-section timing: at 18-24 months corrected age (actual ages 19.9 ± 2.0 months)
